==> /etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml <==
flannel-iface: ens10
node-external-ip: 192.0.2.11
node-ip: 10.0.0.3
node-name: node2
server: https://10.0.0.2:6443
token: the-token

==> /etc/rancher/k3s/registries.yaml <==
mirrors:
    moostack.local:
        endpoint:
            - http://10.0.0.2:5000

==> /etc/systemd/system/k3s-agent.service.d/memory.conf <==
[Service]
Environment=GOGC=25
Environment=GOMEMLIMIT=196MiB

==> /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/kubelet.conf.d/10-moostack.conf <==
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
evictionHard:
    memory.available: 100Mi
kind: KubeletConfiguration
kubeReserved:
    memory: 250Mi
systemReserved:
    memory: 200Mi
